## Functional identification

The protein is the **large subunit of 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase**, encoded by **LeuC**.

- **Enzyme:** 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large subunit  
- **EC number:** **EC 4.2.1.33**  
- **Complex:** Heterodimer with the small **LeuD** subunit  
- **Cofactor:** One **[4Fe–4S] cluster per subunit**  
- **Pathway:** L-leucine biosynthesis  
- **Domain:** Aconitase-family domain, Pfam **PF00330**, spanning approximately residues 7–462  

### Catalytic reaction

\[
\text{(2R,3S)-3-isopropylmalate}
\rightleftharpoons
\text{(2S)-2-isopropylmalate}
\]

The reaction proceeds through the intermediate **2-isopropylmaleate**. It is a reversible dehydration/rehydration isomerization and does **not** involve net oxidation–reduction:

\[
\text{3-isopropylmalate}
\rightleftharpoons
\text{2-isopropylmaleate}
\rightleftharpoons
\text{2-isopropylmalate}
\]

## Evidence and confidence

This assignment is highly confident: the 483-residue sequence is an **exact full-length sequence match** to reviewed UniProt protein **A1R7K0**, annotated as 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large subunit. Close reviewed homologs show 94–95% identity and carry the same catalytic, cofactor, pathway, and subunit annotations.
